headline: So I built a Chrome extension that filters my Twitter feed for AI slop, repeated stories, and content that’s actually irrelevant to me.

media.alt: Video from the post by Suvendu Sekhar Sahoo

text:
I wanted to make my doomscrolling a little more useful.

So I built a Chrome extension that filters my Twitter feed for AI slop, repeated stories, and content that’s actually irrelevant to me.

Built with Jev by TypeSafe. Probabilities → code → verdict.
